Great vet, saved my cat's life!🐱😍
Thank you🙏
We usually take both of our dogs to the doctor, he is always very helpful and thorough, I can only recommend him.

We arrived for the first time with our injured cat, unknown to us. The doctor was very nice even on the phone, and in person we received a thorough examination and quick help. The cat is getting better, thank you very much and I recommend him with confidence!
Our dog loves it, he goes in on his own, whether he wants to or not.
Very kind and vprofessional veterinary.

Today we took my recently adopted 5-year-old dog to Dr. Úr to get his mandatory vaccinations and deworming. I am extremely satisfied with the service. Dr. Úr was kind and helpful in everything, I received satisfactory answers to all my questions. And he was very friendly with my dog! I will also have the necessary medical consultation with him! :)

We have been going to Dr. Uř since our Labrador puppy was a puppy, for more than 5 years now. He usually gives us the annual mandatory vaccinations, and if any problem arises, we always turn to him and he helps us fix the problem with maximum expertise every time. For a year now, we have been treating epilepsy with the help of Dr. Uř with the medicine and natural nutritional supplement recommended by Dr. Uř, and recently we visited him for allergy complaints, where he immediately helped alleviate the complaints. We always turn to him with confidence, because no matter what problem arises, he always helps us.

Thank you!
Dr. Yaro
The doctor is a very kind and professional specialist.
Easily accessible location, kind, knowledgeable doctor. My cat received very good care. Thank you

The Doctor is a very good specialist! My puppy Molly was very sick, so unfortunately we have been to many doctors and hospitals with her, but we have never met such a precise and thorough doctor. We are grateful to him, and as long as we can, we will definitely go to him. 🙏😊 …
Everything went quickly and smoothly; I met a conscientious and helpful person in the person of the doctor. I recommend it!

I would like to thank Dr. Yaro for conscientiously operating on our dog Dézi on Sunday and for always being reliable.
If you are looking for a conscientious veterinarian, not a profit-oriented one, you can count on him.
An empathetic, conscientious doctor who truly puts animals first. He helps pets with alternative, effective treatments.
Great. Good.
Thank you!

We would like to thank Dr. Yaro for always being available. It is obvious that his heartfelt love for animals motivates him to help on a daily basis.
Thanks: Öcsi and his family

My little one has been treated for cerebellar ataxia several times, he didn't want to put her to sleep like the neurologist, he helped Tina when she was bleeding, they are not afraid of the Doctor because he loves them, I owe them respect and gratitude😻 …

The doctor is very kind, I can only recommend him. We have taken our cats for vaccinations so far, there were no problems. We always called before, we never waited more than 10 minutes. I recommend him!
The doctor was very nice and helpful.

1991! That's when I met Yaro at the age of 11. He taught me everything there was to know about dogs, how to administer medicine.... We let my first companion cross the rainbow bridge together at the age of 17 and he also taught me how to let go! I didn't take my current dog to him for 6 years because he moved away and I thought he was far away! Life brought him so that I found him and he welcomed me as if a minute had not passed. I am grateful to him for treating my dog ​​realistically and humanely and telling me everything I need to know, which is why I trust him. He doesn't recommend the most expensive treatments but helps find the best for everyone! The most important thing he taught me is that diagnosing a dog largely depends on the owner!!! I thank him for everything!

We would like to thank Dr. Yaro Cletus for the professional medical care he provided to our cat, Tequila.

Our story in short:
Our 15-year-old tabby cat accidentally got a scratch on his eye, which resulted in a bad infection and his vision in that eye became uncertain.

After an examination, Dr. Cletus prescribed antibiotics and recommended turmeric powder extract as an additional treatment with a course of at least 2 months.

The result was more than satisfactory, as the inflammation completely disappeared and the cat's vision was perfectly restored.

It's been almost a year since then, Tequila is doing well, thank you very much, there is no trace of the previous inflammation! 😄

I can only recommend Dr. Cletus to everyone! We and our little pet, Tequila, are extremely satisfied with his expertise and the way he treats animals.
